Geographies Served Programs Educational And Nutritional Support To The Poor And Needy Single Parent Children District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Ashadeep Association works towards enhancing the lives of the deprived and needy single parent children, orphans and widows. Ashadeep offers personal attention to the children and provides tuitions to groom the children and guide them the right way. To fulfil this objective, we are running 6 study centres for the under privileged children at our 6 “DayCare” centres in the western suburbs of Mumbai. A hungry child would not be able to focus or be attentive in studies. Therefore, Ashadeep provides nutritious food for the development of children. Ashadeep signifies a glimmer of hope to these children and their mother because they have been brought out of darkness and are placed in the light, a light which continues to glow for their bright future. To fulfill this objective, there are running 7 study centers for the under privileged children at their day care Centre in the western suburbs of Mumbai. This includes provision of school uniforms and study material, assisting children with enrolment into schools and colleges, supervision of homework and studies, individual coaching in senior grade and academic guidance and counseling. Output: 1. Better understanding of the subjects by the students. 2. A positive approach towards academic and studies among the children. 3. Preparation for the higher studies or professional courses. 4. The nutritious food keeps them energetic and with fresh mind they show eagerness to study.
